Birmingham Exhibition
Example
•    Purpose of calling: purchasing tickets
•    Open in:
•    Length of exhibition:
•    A wide range of manufacturers will be showcased.
•    Some cars are available to observe and the others are for
•    The is prohibited to take into the museum.
•    Every ticket includes one free photo.
•    Price of ticket: £ (in advance)

analyses.content: 录音中工作人员明确说明汽车展览将在七月（The exhibition will take place during July）举行。

女士先提问“能否向我提供更多信息”（...whether you could provide me with some more information），紧接着才问“是六月开幕吗？”；工作人员回答的“Yes, of course”是对前一个提问“能否提供信息”的肯定与应答，随后立刻明确说明开展时间是在七月（July），千万不要把“of course”误当成是对六月（June）的肯定，这里是易错点。

My husband and I are interested in purchasing tickets to the Automobile Exhibition, but I couldn't find many details about it on your website, and I was wondering whether you could provide me with some more information. Does it open in June? Yes, of course, madam. The exhibition will take place during July and will showcase the history of automobiles from the very 1st commercial car in the late 1800s all the way through to the present day.
女士询问是否整个七月都开放，男士否定并提到展会仅持续3天（last 3 days）。
你可能会顺着前面“July”的思路期待一个具体的长日期，听到“last 3 days”时需要迅速反应过来这对应题干的“Length of exhibition”。
Is the exhibition open for the duration of July? No, madam. The exhibition will last 3 days, from the 1st of July to the 3rd of July, and then the cars will be taken to another exhibition.
录音明确指出，有一部分车只能观察（observe），而有一些更现代的车肯定有机会可以试驾（test driving）。
你可能听到了前面的“drive”，但题目需要准确填出对应modern cars的完整动作，不要漏掉“test”。

Are there any opportunities to sit in or even drive the cars? There will be many opportunities for you to sit in the cars. However, some of the cars will only be available to observe. We are yet to be told whether any of the antique cars will be available to drive. However, there will certainly be an opportunity to test driving some of the more modern cars on a purpose-built track.
女士刚提到不能忘记带相机（camera），男士立刻提醒相机被严格禁止带入展览（strictly not allowed to bring into...），完美对应题干的prohibited。
你可能会因为男士用的是复数“cameras”而犹豫，但题干前面有“The”，所以这里填单数camera即可，重点是跟上“not allowed”的同义替换。

I mustn't forget to bring my camera, or my husband will never forgive me. I'm afraid to say that cameras are actually strictly not allowed to bring into the exhibition. There will, however, be a section where a professional photographer will be available to take photos of you sitting in a car in period clothing.
男士详细说明了票价机制：如果提前买（in advance），价格是110英镑。
你可能听到了女士猜测的100 pounds，或者现场买的165 pounds，这里必须盯紧题干里的“in advance”来做干扰排除。

I've been asking around about the ticket prices, but I haven't yet had a definite answer. Is it correct that the tickets are 100 pounds, whether you buy them now or on arrival? I'm afraid not. If you buy the ticket in advance, the price is 110 pounds, but it's 165 pounds on the door.
男士说要转接给票房经理，并直接拼出了他的姓氏：E-D-G-E-W-O-R-T-H。
这是一道纯粹的拼写题，你可能因为跟不上拼写速度或字母发音辨别失误（比如E和A）而写错，平时要加强字母听写反应。

Is it possible to buy tickets from you now over the phone? Yes, of course, madam. I'll transfer you to the box office manager, Mark Edgeworth. That's E-D-G-E-W-O-R-T-H. And he will probably need to take your credit card details and some personal details.
女士以为是在伯明翰展览中心，男士纠正说那里在翻修，今年的展览将在夏宫（Summer Palace）举行。
你可能听到了干扰项Birmingham Exhibition Center，但是“No, madam”这个否定信号词一出现，你就必须知道答案在后面。

Will the exhibition be held in the Birmingham Exhibition Center? I think that's where I went last time. No, madam. The Birmingham Exhibition Center is currently undergoing some renovations, so this year all exhibitions will be held in the Summer Palace.
男士解释地点时，原词重现了题干的逻辑，指出那里离市中心（city center）不太远（not too far from）。
这道题定位非常直接，如果你走神或者在纠结上一题的Summer Palace，很容易就漏听了这句紧随其后的方位说明。

Summer Palace? I'm not entirely sure where that is. Well, it's not too far from city center. Once you're in the center, you should be able to find signs for the palace. If not, most people in Birmingham will be able to direct you.
男士建议女士访问网站获取详细信息，并清晰读出了网址 www.directions.com。
网址题直接听写即可，但你极容易漏掉结尾的复数“s”，写成direction，一定要仔细听尾音。

Is there anywhere I can find this information on the internet? Our website will give you an address. Perhaps you could visit www.directions.com for more detailed information, and they should be able to provide you with step-by-step instructions.
女士问电话是不是最好的联系方式，男士纠正说最方便（most convenient）的联系方式是线上询问（inquiring online）。
你可能听到提问里的“by phone”就以为是答案，必须等对方给出结论；同时注意most convenient是对best的完美同义替换。

Okay. And is this the best way to contact you, by phone? I think the most convenient way to contact us is inquiring online, which is much simpler than having to dial various different numbers to reach the right person. Unless you have any more questions, I'll transfer you now.
